title: Soundness failure witness
statement: Given a refutation data package and Boolean lists $x,U,u,v,w,r$, a soundness-failure witness consists of all of the following: the length of $v$ equals the package's second block-length bound evaluated at the encoding of $(x,u)$; the query relation holds for $U$ and the concatenation of the encoding of $(x,u,v)$ with $w$; the length of $r$ is at most $C_3$ times one plus the length of the encoding of $(x,u,v)$, raised to $c_3$; and the encoding of $(x,u,v,r)$ belongs to the package's language $R$.
hypotheses_covered: A refutation data package is fixed
The stated four conditions hold jointly
caveat: The pair encoding and query relation are not defined in the supplied material.
